payload.note: Linear-pair power-reduction checkpoint: a new all-leg quintic bound abs(K5)<=8*product_i sqrt(omega_i), exact soft-factor allocations, and a four-dimensional max-norm three-weight convolution lemma prove abs(I3)<=5772060*pi^3*L and abs(I6)<=15360*pi^3*L*[11/16+(1/2)*log floor(L/2)] for every L>=5. Thus pairs 3 and 6 are O(L) and O(L log L), respectively, and are little-o of N*omega(p). Together with pairs 1, 2, and 5, five of seven inversion pairs have zero leading power coefficient. The N*omega(p) gate is reduced to the signed competition between negative pair 4 and positive pair 7. A supporting, noncertifying asymptotic derivation identifies pair 4's candidate soft lattice-sum coefficient and pair 7's hard-hard derivative integral; their limits and noncancellation remain open. Tuned-g4 uniformity of the subleading sector, complete M4, the nonperturbative score, and actual interacting H^-1 remain open. No continuum, Born, Krein, or Lorentzian promotion is made.
